#MASS_IND_EXPECTED = (MASS_POP * SIZE_IND) / SIZE_POP = (MASS_POP / SIZE_POP) * SIZE_IND 
data_mass <- read.csv(file=here::here("data",
                                      "Data_weight_Asellus2025.csv"))
head(data_mass)
##   Bac Ind Bac_Ind Mass   Size

## 3  A1   3    A1_3 0.63 0.0908

1.2 Add Ratio Mass

  #MASS_IND_EXPECTED = (MASS_POP * SIZE_IND) / SIZE_POP = (MASS_POP / SIZE_POP) * SIZE_IND 
data_mass$Ratio <- data_mass$Mass / data_mass$Size


MEAN_RATIO <- mean(data_mass$Ratio)

### Option alternative : 
data_mass$log_mass <- log(data_mass$Mass)
data_mass$log_size <- log(data_mass$Size)
lm_masssize <- lm(log_mass ~ log_size, data = data_mass)

a_log <- coef(lm_masssize)[1]  # intercept (log(a))
b <- coef(lm_masssize)[2]      # slope (b)
a <- exp(a_log)

 


## Not enough values per pop or per evol history 
# For more details : see Analysis_RATIO_Mass_Size folder and figures 

data_length$Ratio <- MEAN_RATIO

data_length$Mass_Ind <- a*(data_length$Length^b)


# As factor
data_length$Tpop <- as.factor(data_length$Tpop)
data_length$Pop <- as.factor(data_length$Pop)
data_length$Predpop <- as.factor(data_length$Predpop)


## CHECK OUTLIER

1.3 Merge Length and respiro

keys = c("Ref", "ID_photo", "Round", "TempExp", "Reader", "TempExpNum", "Pop", 
         "PopInd", "Tpop", "Predpop", "Survival", "Naivety")
keys = intersect(names(data_length), names(data_respiro))



# Merge
datamerged <- merge(
  data_length, data_respiro,
  by = keys,
  all = TRUE,
  suffixes = c(".len", ".resp"))

# --- Simple mismatch check ---
common_cols <- intersect(names(data_length), names(data_respiro))
common_cols <- setdiff(common_cols, keys)

for (col in common_cols) {
  col_len  <- paste0(col, ".len")
  col_resp <- paste0(col, ".resp")
  if (all(col_len %in% names(datamerged), col_resp %in% names(datamerged))) {
    mismatch <- sum(datamerged[[col_len]] != datamerged[[col_resp]], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (mismatch > 0) {
      warning(sprintf("Column %s has %d mismatched values", col, mismatch))
    }
  }
}

## OUTLIER EMMA 
# Calculer l'IQR du jeu de données
q1 <- stats::quantile(datamerged$Slope_Corrected, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- stats::quantile(datamerged$Slope_Corrected, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
iqr <- q3 - q1
# Définir la plage de valeurs acceptables
lower <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
upper <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr

plot_rawdata + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = lower) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = upper)

hist(datamerged$Length)

mod0 <- lme4::lmer(Length ~ Tpop:Predpop + Tpop + Predpop + (1|Pop), data = datamerged, 
      REML=FALSE) #To compare model

#hist(resid(mod0))
mod1 <- lme4::lmer(Length ~ Tpop + Predpop + (1|Pop), data = datamerged, 
      REML=FALSE) #To compare model

anova(mod0,mod1,test="Chisq") #Remove Interaction
## Data: datamerged
## Models:
## mod1: Length ~ Tpop + Predpop + (1 | Pop)
## mod0: Length ~ Tpop:Predpop + Tpop + Predpop + (1 | Pop)
##      npar    AIC    BIC logLik -2*log(L)  Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)
## mod1    5 -11443 -11415 5726.7    -11453                     
## mod0    6 -11443 -11409 5727.5    -11455 1.5712  1       0.21
mod2 <- lme4::lmer(Length ~ Predpop + (1|Pop), data = datamerged, 
      REML=FALSE) #To compare model
mod3 <- lme4::lmer(Length ~ Tpop + (1|Pop), data = datamerged, 
      REML=FALSE) #To compare model
anova(mod1,mod2,test="Chisq") #Remove Predpop
## Data: datamerged
## Models:
## mod2: Length ~ Predpop + (1 | Pop)
## mod1: Length ~ Tpop + Predpop + (1 | Pop)
##      npar    AIC    BIC logLik -2*log(L)  Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)
## mod2    4 -11445 -11422 5726.4    -11453                     
## mod1    5 -11443 -11415 5726.7    -11453 0.5954  1     0.4403
anova(mod1,mod3,test="Chisq") #Remove Tpop
## Data: datamerged
## Models:
## mod3: Length ~ Tpop + (1 | Pop)
## mod1: Length ~ Tpop + Predpop + (1 | Pop)
##      npar    AIC    BIC logLik -2*log(L)  Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)
## mod3    4 -11445 -11422 5726.4    -11453                     
## mod1    5 -11443 -11415 5726.7    -11453 0.5593  1     0.4545
modnull <- lme4::lmer(Length ~ 1 + (1|Pop), data = datamerged, 
      REML=FALSE) 
anova(modnull,mod2,test="Chisq") #Remove Predpop
## Data: datamerged
## Models:
## modnull: Length ~ 1 + (1 | Pop)
## mod2: Length ~ Predpop + (1 | Pop)
##         npar    AIC    BIC logLik -2*log(L)  Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)
## modnull    3 -11446 -11429 5726.2    -11452                     
## mod2       4 -11445 -11422 5726.4    -11453 0.4289  1     0.5126
anova(modnull,mod3,test="Chisq") #Remove Tpop
## Data: datamerged
## Models:
## modnull: Length ~ 1 + (1 | Pop)

3.3.1 AIC best model

plot_rawdata <- ggplot() + 
  geom_jitter(data = datamerged_respiro, 
                       aes(x = TempExpNum, y = log(Slope_Pos), 
                           group = interaction(Predpop,Tpop),
                           color = interaction(Predpop,Tpop), 
                           shape = interaction(Predpop,Tpop)), 
                       alpha = 0.8, size = 0.8) + 
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Evolution history",
                    labels=c("Ctrl.Ambiant" = "Ambient x NoPred" ,
                             "Pred.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Pred" ,
                              "Ctrl.Warm" = "Warm x NoPred",
                             "Pred.Warm" = "Warm x Pred" ),
                    values = c(16,17,16,17)) +  
  scale_color_manual(name = "Evolution history",
                    labels=c("Ctrl.Ambiant" = "Ambient x NoPred" ,
                             "Pred.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Pred" ,
                              "Ctrl.Warm" = "Warm x NoPred",
                             "Pred.Warm" = "Warm x Pred" ),
                    values = c("#92c5de","#0571b0","#f4a582","#ca0020")) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
  xlab("Experimental temperature") +
  ylab("Log(Slope Respiro)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = datamerged$TempExpNum) +
  theme_LO_sobre 
plot_rawdata

     data = datamerged_respiro_clean, REML=FALSE)

ModLinear <- lme4::lmer(log(Slope_Pos) ~ TempExpNum + log(Mass_Ind) + (1|Pop),
     data = datamerged_respiro_clean, REML=FALSE)

ModHetero <-  nlme::lme(fixed = log(Slope_Pos) ~ TempExpNum + log(Mass_Ind)  ,
  random = ~1 | Pop, weights = nlme::varPower(form = ~ TempExpNum), 
  data = datamerged_respiro_clean, method = "ML") 

ModSpine <- nlme::lme(log(Slope_Pos) ~  splines::ns(TempExpNum, 3) + log(Mass_Ind),
  random = ~1 | Pop,
  weights = nlme::varPower(form = ~ TempExpNum), 
  data = datamerged_respiro_clean, method = "ML")


ModNull <- lm(log(Slope_Pos) ~ 1,

AIC(ModLinear,ModHetero,ModSpine,ModSquare, ModNull)

########## ADD PREDICTIONS

#Make prediction grid
newdat <- data.frame(TempExpNum = seq(min(datamerged$TempExpNum),
                                      max(datamerged$TempExpNum),
                                      length.out = 100), 
                     Mass_Ind = mean(datamerged_respiro_clean$Mass_Ind))
newdat$TempExpNumSquare <- newdat$TempExpNum*newdat$TempExpNum
#Get predictions
newdat$Linear <- predict(ModLinear, newdata = newdat, re.form = NA)
newdat$Square <- predict(ModSquare, newdata = newdat, re.form = NA)
newdat$Hetero <- predict(ModHetero, newdata = newdat, level = 0)
newdat$Spine  <- predict(ModSpine,  newdata = newdat, level = 0)
newdat$Null  <- predict(ModNull,  newdata = newdat, level = 0)

# 3. Reshape for ggplot
pred_long <- reshape(newdat,
  varying = names(newdat)[-1],   # all columns except TempExpNum
  v.names = "Fit",
  timevar = "Model",
  times = names(newdat)[-1],
  direction = "long")


pred_long <- pred_long[pred_long$Model!="Mass_Ind",]
pred_long <- pred_long[pred_long$Model!="TempExpNumSquare",]

pred_long <- rbind(pred_long[,c(1,2,3)])



# 4. Add lines to your existing plot
plot_allmodels <- plot_rawdata +
  facet_wrap(~ Model, nrow = 1) +
  geom_line(data = pred_long,
            aes(x = TempExpNum, y = Fit),
            size = 1.2)
plot_allmodels

#Predict dataset
dat_predict_respiro <- data.frame(TempExpNum = seq(min(datamerged_respiro_clean$TempExpNum),
                                      max(datamerged_respiro_clean$TempExpNum),
                                      length.out = 10), 
                     Mass_Ind = mean(datamerged_respiro_clean$Mass_Ind))

# Buildd the design matrix
X <- model.matrix(formula(nlme_best)[-2], dat_predict_respiro)


#extract fixed effects
fixef <- nlme::fixed.effects(nlme_best)
fixed_pred <- as.vector(X %*% fixef)

#Random effects
sd_pop <- as.numeric(nlme::VarCorr(nlme_best)[1, "StdDev"])
sd_resid <- nlme_best$sigma

# Number of simulations
nsim <- 5000



pred_boot <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(dat_predict_respiro), ncol = nsim)

pops <- unique(datamerged_respiro_clean$Pop)

for(i in 1:nsim){
  # residuals (heteroscedasticity is modeled via varPower, ideally we should scale resid by fitted values, but here we keep it simple)
  resid_sim <- rnorm(nrow(dat_predict_respiro), 0, sd_resid)
  
  # total prediction = fixed + random + residual
  lp <- fixed_pred  + resid_sim
  pred_boot[, i] <- lp
}

# 95% CI
# dat_predict_respiro$CI_lower <- apply(pred_boot, 1, quantile, 0.025)
# dat_predict_respiro$CI_upper <- apply(pred_boot, 1, quantile, 0.975)



## Estimate 
dat_predict_respiro$predict <- predict(nlme_best,
                                       newdata = dat_predict_respiro,
                                       level = 0)
dat_predict_respiro$CI_lower <- apply(pred_boot, 1, quantile, 0.025)
dat_predict_respiro$CI_upper <- apply(pred_boot, 1, quantile, 0.975)

dat_predict_respiro[which.max(dat_predict_respiro$predict), ]

## PredpopPred -0.630  0.550 -0.082              
## TmpExpNm:PP  0.546 -0.626  0.072 -0.869       
## TmpExpNm:TW  0.374 -0.429 -0.868  0.072 -0.088
## optimizer (nloptwrap) convergence code: 0 (OK)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
tapply(data_decompo_clean$Deg_Rate_Raffard, data_decompo_clean$Pop, mean)
##         A1         B1         B2         B4         B5         B7         B9 
## 0.02132954 0.02192389 0.02051891 0.01890208 0.02071124 0.01939093 0.02015581 
##          C         C1         C3         C5         C9         D6         D7 
##         NA 0.01977345 0.01919240 0.02152386 0.01964130 0.02058760 0.02203212
tapply(data_decompo_clean$Deg_Rate_Raffard, data_decompo_clean$EvolHistory, mean)
##          C_C Ctrl_Ambiant    Ctrl_Warm Pred_Ambiant    Pred_Warm 
##           NA   0.02097473   0.02197800   0.01937731   0.02008599
# ####################################
# ############################ PREDICT 
# ####################################
anova(modbest)
## Analysis of Variance Table
##                    npar    Sum Sq   Mean Sq  F value
## TempExpNum            1 0.0050316 0.0050316 778.3269
## Tpop                  1 0.0000171 0.0000171   2.6474
## Predpop               1 0.0000704 0.0000704  10.8830
## TempExpNum:Predpop    1 0.0001102 0.0001102  17.0430
## TempExpNum:Tpop       1 0.0000442 0.0000442   6.8437
## BEST MODEL 
modbest <- lme4::lmer(Deg_Rate_Raffard ~  TempExpNum:Predpop + TempExpNum:Tpop + 
     TempExpNum + Tpop + Predpop  + (1|Pop), 
     data = data_decompo_clean) #To compare model
summary(modbest)
## Linear mixed model fit by REML ['lmerMod']
## Formula: 
## Deg_Rate_Raffard ~ TempExpNum:Predpop + TempExpNum:Tpop + TempExpNum +  
##     Tpop + Predpop + (1 | Pop)
##    Data: data_decompo_clean
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: -966.2
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -2.17967 -0.63881  0.01926  0.57022  3.14119 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance  Std.Dev.
##  Pop      (Intercept) 0.000e+00 0.000000
##  Residual             6.465e-06 0.002543
## Number of obs: 116, groups:  Pop, 13
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                          Estimate Std. Error t value
## (Intercept)             8.247e-03  7.883e-04  10.462
## TempExpNum              8.034e-04  4.318e-05  18.607
## TpopWarm               -1.276e-03  9.800e-04  -1.302
## PredpopPred             2.050e-03  9.617e-04   2.132
## TempExpNum:PredpopPred -2.302e-04  5.302e-05  -4.342
## TempExpNum:TpopWarm     1.416e-04  5.414e-05   2.616
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr) TmpExN TppWrm PrdppP TEN:PP
## TempExpNum  -0.872                            
## TpopWarm    -0.433  0.378                     
## PredpopPred -0.630  0.550 -0.082              
## TmpExpNm:PP  0.546 -0.626  0.072 -0.869       
## TmpExpNm:TW  0.374 -0.429 -0.868  0.072 -0.088
## optimizer (nloptwrap) convergence code: 0 (OK)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
# Obtain slopes of TempExpNum for all combinations of Predpop and Tpop
slopes <- emmeans::emtrends(modbest, ~ Predpop + Tpop, var = "TempExpNum")
summary(slopes)
##  Predpop Tpop    TempExpNum.trend       SE  df lower.CL upper.CL
##  Ctrl    Ambiant         0.000803 4.32e-05 101 0.000718 0.000889
##  Pred    Ambiant         0.000573 4.25e-05 100 0.000489 0.000658
##  Ctrl    Warm            0.000945 5.28e-05 100 0.000840 0.001050
##  Pred    Warm            0.000715 4.72e-05 100 0.000621 0.000808
## 
## Degrees-of-freedom method: kenward-roger 
## Confidence level used: 0.95
dat_predict_decompo <-expand.grid(TempExpNum=seq(min(
  data_decompo_clean$TempExpNum),
  max(data_decompo_clean$TempExpNum), 1),
                                   Tpop = unique(data_decompo_clean$Tpop),
                                   Predpop = unique(data_decompo_clean$Predpop))



#Predict
dat_predict_decompo$predict <- predict(modbest, type = "response",
                                  re.form = NA,
                                  newdata = dat_predict_decompo)

#Confidence interval
bb <- lme4::bootMer(modbest,
              FUN=function(x)predict(x,
                                     newdata = dat_predict_decompo,
                                     re.form=NA),
              nsim=5000)

# Take quantiles of predictions from bootstrap replicates.
# These represent the confidence interval of the mean at any value of Time.
dat_predict_decompo$CI_lower <- apply(bb$t, 2, quantile, 0.025)
dat_predict_decompo$CI_upper <- apply(bb$t, 2, quantile, 0.975)


dat_predict_decompo[dat_predict_decompo$TempExpNum==27,]
##    TempExpNum    Tpop Predpop    predict   CI_lower   CI_upper
## 23         27 Ambiant    Ctrl 0.02993865 0.02869727 0.03114175
## 46         27    Warm    Ctrl 0.03248731 0.03100875 0.03394629
## 69         27 Ambiant    Pred 0.02577282 0.02459515 0.02698201
## 92         27    Warm    Pred 0.02832147 0.02695897 0.02968500
## PLOT


plot_predict_decompo <- ggplot(data = dat_predict_decompo,
        aes(x = TempExpNum, y = predict, group = interaction(Predpop,Tpop))) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(data = dat_predict_decompo,
                       aes(ymin = CI_lower,
                           ymax = CI_upper,
                           x = TempExpNum,
                           color = interaction(Predpop,Tpop),
                           fill = interaction(Predpop,Tpop),
                           group = interaction(Predpop,Tpop)),
                       alpha = 0.1, size = 0.05) +
  geom_jitter(data = data_decompo_clean,
                       aes(x = TempExpNum, y = Deg_Rate_Raffard,
                           color = interaction(Predpop,Tpop),
                           shape = interaction(Predpop,Tpop)),
                       alpha = 0.8, size = 1.2, position = position_dodge(width = 1)) +
  geom_line(data = dat_predict_decompo,
            aes(x = TempExpNum,
                y = predict,
                group = interaction(Predpop,Tpop),
                linetype = interaction(Predpop,Tpop),
                color = interaction(Predpop,Tpop)),
            size = 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Evolutionary conditions",
                    labels=c("Ctrl.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Predator-free" ,
                             "Pred.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Predator" ,
                              "Ctrl.Warm" = "Warm x Predator-free",
                             "Pred.Warm" = "Warm x Predator" ),
                    values = c(16,17,16,17)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Evolutionary conditions",
                    labels=c("Ctrl.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Predator-free" ,
                             "Pred.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Predator" ,
                              "Ctrl.Warm" = "Warm x Predator-free",
                             "Pred.Warm" = "Warm x Predator"),
                    values = c("dashed","dashed","solid","solid")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Evolutionary conditions",
                    labels=c("Ctrl.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Predator-free" ,
                             "Pred.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Predator" ,
                              "Ctrl.Warm" = "Warm x Predator-free",
                             "Pred.Warm" = "Warm x Predator" ),
                    values = c("#92c5de","#0571b0","#f4a582","#ca0020")) +
 scale_fill_manual(name = "Evolutionary conditions",
                    labels=c("Ctrl.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Predator-free" ,
                             "Pred.Ambiant" = "Ambient x Predator" ,
                              "Ctrl.Warm" = "Warm x Predator-free",

# BACK TRANSFORMATION
# Transformation inverse pour revenir sur l’échelle de Slope_Pos
# newdat$Slope_Pos_pred <- exp(newdat$pred)



# On s'assure que la prédiction est sur l'échelle du métabolisme (exp)
dat_predict_respiro_pop$pred_exp <- exp(dat_predict_respiro_pop$predict)

# Liste des populations
pops <- unique(dat_predict_respiro_pop$Pop)

# Préparer un tableau de résultats
SUM_Respi <- data.frame(Pop = pops,
                      min_temp = NA,
                      max_temp = NA,
                      mean_level = NA,
                      sd_shape = NA,
                      slope_low = NA,
                      slope_high = NA,
                      optimum_temp = NA)


temp_dataevolhistory <- aggregate(EvolHistory ~ Pop, data = datamerged_respiro_clean, FUN = unique)
SUM_Respi <- merge(SUM_Respi, 
                   temp_dataevolhistory[, c("Pop", "EvolHistory")], 
                   by = "Pop", all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
rm(temp_dataevolhistory)

# Boucle sur chaque population
for (i in seq_along(pops)) {
  
  sub <- dat_predict_respiro_pop[dat_predict_respiro_pop$Pop == pops[i], ]
  
  
  SUM_Respi$min_temp[i] <- sub$TempExpNum[which.min(sub$pred_exp)]
  SUM_Respi$max_temp[i]   <- sub$TempExpNum[which.max(sub$pred_exp)]
  
  
  # Niveau moyen et "pointuosité"
  SUM_Respi$mean_level[i] <- mean(sub$pred_exp, na.rm = TRUE)
  SUM_Respi$sd_shape[i]   <- sd(sub$pred_exp, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Sensibilité basse température (ici entre points 1 et 20)
  SUM_Respi$slope_low[i] <- (sub$pred_exp[20] - sub$pred_exp[1]) / 
                          (sub$TempExpNum[20] - sub$TempExpNum[1])
  
  # Sensibilité haute température (ici entre les 180e et 200e points si ~200 valeurs)
  n <- nrow(sub)
  SUM_Respi$slope_high[i] <- (sub$pred_exp[n] - sub$pred_exp[n-20]) / 
                           (sub$TempExpNum[n] - sub$TempExpNum[n-20])
  
  # Optimum thermique
  SUM_Respi$optimum_temp[i] <- sub$TempExpNum[which.max(sub$pred_exp)]
}

# mean_level : moyenne de exp(predict) → niveau moyen du métabolisme
  # populations avec un métabolisme globalement élevé vs bas.
# sd_shape : écart-type de exp(predict) → mesure de la "pointuosité" vs "platitude"
  # faible → courbe presque plate → population tolérante à la T°,
  # forte → courbe bien définie (optimum marqué).
# slope_low : pente entre ~5ème et ~10ème quantile de température
# slope_high : pente entre ~90ème et ~95ème quantile
  # indiquent la force de la réponse aux extrêmes.
# optimum_temp : température où la respiration est maximale (si bien défini).
  # donc correspoind à max_temp


# Regarder correlation entre ces variables

# 1. Garder uniquement les colonnes numériques
num_vars <- SUM_Respi[, c("min_temp", "max_temp", "mean_level", 
                        "sd_shape", "slope_low", "slope_high", "optimum_temp")]
# 2. Matrice de corrélation
cor_mat <- cor(num_vars, use = "complete.obs")
# 3. Conversion en format long pour ggplot
cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat))
colnames(cor_df) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "Correlation")
cor_df <- cor_df[as.numeric(cor_df$Var1) < as.numeric(cor_df$Var2), ]
# 4. Heatmap
ggplot(cor_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = Correlation)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Correlation, 2)), size = 3) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white",
                       midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1, 1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Heatmap des corrélations entre métriques de populations",
       fill = "Corrélation")

##### Metrics

5.1.3 Decompo

SUM_Decompo <- data_decompo_clean %>%
  group_by(Pop, EvolHistory) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Deg_Rate_Raffard, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") 

# Model
mod <- lm(Deg_Rate_Raffard ~ TempExpNum*Pop, data = data_decompo_clean)

coefs <- coef(mod)
pops <- levels(data_decompo_clean$Pop)
pops <- pops[pops != "C"]

# Initialiser les pentes avec NA
slopes <- data.frame(Pop = pops, Slope = NA_real_)
slopes$Slope[1] <- coefs["TempExpNum"]

# Les autres Pop (on aligne correctement les interactions)
for (i in 2:length(pops)) {
  term <- paste0("TempExpNum:Pop", pops[i])
  slopes$Slope[i] <- coefs["TempExpNum"] + coefs[term]
}


# Merge
SUM_Decompo <- data_decompo_clean %>%
  group_by(Pop, EvolHistory) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Deg_Rate_Raffard, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(slopes, by = "Pop")

5.2.3 Permutation - Confidence interval

nsimul <- 10000
res_simul <- numeric(nsimul) 

# Mean_Mass
res_simul <- numeric(nsimul) 
for (i in 1:nsimul) {
  idx_remove <- sample(1:nrow(SUM_Mass), size = 1)
  SUM_Mass_subset <- SUM_Mass[-idx_remove, ]
  mod_mean_mass <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(Mean ~ 1 + (1 | EvolHistory/Pop), data = SUM_Mass_subset)
  res <- compute_PST_glmmTMB(mod_mean_mass)
  res_simul[i] <- res$PST
}

data_sum_PST[data_sum_PST$Var=="Mean_Mass",]$CI.low <- stats::quantile(res_simul,0.025)
data_sum_PST[data_sum_PST$Var=="Mean_Mass",]$CI.up <- stats::quantile(res_simul,0.975)



# RESPIRO 
res_simul <- numeric(nsimul) 
for (i in 1:nsimul) {
  idx_remove <- sample(1:nrow(SUM_Respi), size = 1)
  SUM_subset <- SUM_Respi[-idx_remove, ]
  mod_subset <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(mean_level ~ 1 + (1 | EvolHistory/Pop), data = SUM_subset)
  res <- compute_PST_glmmTMB(mod_subset)
  res_simul[i] <- res$PST
  rm(mod_subset,SUM_subset,res)
}

#                    labels = c("Mean Mass", "Mean metabolic rate",
#                               "Temperature-dependent\noptimum metabolic rate",

# plotPSTFST

plotPSTFST <- ggplot(data_sum_PST, aes(x = PST_percent, y = Var)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Var), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI.low_percent, xmax = CI.up_percent, color = Var), 
                 height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 21.67, lty = 1, color = "indianred2") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20.98, lty = 2, color = "indianred2") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 22.34, lty = 2, color = "indianred2") + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "<span style='color:indianred2;'>Fst    </span> <span style='color:white;'>------------- </span> <span style='color:black;'>Pst        </span> <span style='color:white;'>------_____----- </span>", 
    y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(breaks = unique(data_sum_PST$Var), 
    labels = c("Mean body mass", "Mean metabolic rate",
               "Temperature-dependent\noptimum metabolic rate",
               "Thermal breadth of\nmetabolic rate",
               "Mean decomposition rate", 
               "Temperature-dependent\ndecomposition rate")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mean_Mass" = "#2176AE",
      "Mean_Respiro" = "#2176AE",
      "Slope_Optimum_Respiro" = "#2176AE",
      "Slope_Sd_Respiro" = "black",
      "Mean_Decompo" = "#2176AE",
      "Slope_Decompo" = "#2176AE")) +
  theme_LO_sobre +
  theme(axis.title.x = ggtext::element_markdown(),
        legend.position = "none")  # hide legend if not needed

plotPSTFST
